Alex — thanks again for a thoughtful discovery call this morning. Quick recap and suggested next step so we can lock the technical review in: 

- Goal: 60–75 minute private/VPC architecture review to confirm network requirements, authentication/KMS approach, and an ops runbook for cutover.
- Who should attend: your CTO (Priya), lead infra engineer, and our Solutions Engineer (Connor).
- Deliverables for the meeting: network diagram, list of egress destinations (IP ranges/ports), and any current compliance constraints (retention/KMS).

Can you confirm the two people on your side who should be in the room and share a preferred time window next week? I attached a short checklist (privarch-reqs.docx) that outlines the items Connor will ask about — it's not exhaustive but helps the call be productive.

Proposed time range: Tue–Thu next week, mornings PT for your east coast folks or early afternoons PT for your Europe folks. If it helps, I can send a Doodle / Calendly link with 3 slots.

Next steps (simple):
1) Confirm attendees on your side (names + titles)
2) Pick a preferred time window (I can follow up with exact slots)
3) Share the network diagram before the call if available

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,

Pre-call asks (short):
- Network diagram (if you can't share full details, a tiered view is fine)
- List of outbound IP ranges and destination services (DNS, S3, monitoring endpoints)

Once a slot is selected Connor will send a short agenda and the meeting invite. We’ll keep the session focused and action-oriented.

Thanks — I’ll hold the Tuesday slot tentatively until I hear back.

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: HealthNest — private architecture review: quick recap & next step

Alex / Priya — Connor from Redwood's SE team here. Thanks for looping me in. A few practical notes so the architecture review is efficient:

Agenda (proposed, 60 minutes):
1) 10m — Introductions & success criteria for the session
2) 25m — Walkthrough of your network diagram + outbound endpoints
3) 15m — Discussion of authentication model (KMS/HSM, key access patterns) and required audit/logging
4) 10m — Ops cutover plan and immediate open items / owners

Tech prep (if available before the call):
- CIDR blocks / egress IP ranges (or cloud NAT details)
- Expected request throughput (peak RPS) and typical token budget per request (helps sizing)
- Any compliance docs that affect data handling (HIPAA, SOC 2 specifics)

If Marcus can share a short one-page traffic profile (roughs are fine) that helps us bring the right quantization and batching recommendations. I’ll also prepare a short runbook template and a list of questions for the call.

I’m available for any pre-call sync if you want me to hop on for 20 minutes the day before.

Cheers,
Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199
